verdict.rationale: Orama's core is an open-source search library installed via npm/yarn/pnpm/bun and run inside your own application at no cost, so it is self-hosted by design (orama-docs-12, orama-gh-6), with full-text, vector and hybrid search (orama-gh-2). Orama Cloud also offers on-premise support for deploying the context server on your own infrastructure (orama-docs-8). APIs are aligned so projects can move between Cloud and Open Source (orama-docs-19). missing for 10: on-prem Cloud deployment is documented in only one sentence with no setup guide, the open-source AnswerSession relies on Orama Cloud's Secure Proxy rather than being fully self-contained (orama-docs-18), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
